title: Attribute sanitizer and exporter negotiator for multi-backend trace compatibility
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a middleware component in the trace pipeline that sanitizes high-cardinality attributes, normalizes common tag/key names across vendors, and negotiates exporter-specific envelopes so a single OTLP ingest can be reliably routed to Tempo, Jaeger, and third-party backends without schema explosions or dropouts.
acceptance_criteria: Sanitizer applies configurable key allowlist/denylist and truncation rules at ingest and during exporter negotiation
Attribute mappings (e.g., service.*, http.status_code, user.id) are normalized into our canonical schema and documented
Per-exporter negotiation layer transforms envelope to backend-compatible format (Tempo protobuf over gRPC, Jaeger Thrift/HTTP, vendor JSON) with tests
End-to-end tests demonstrate <1% dropped spans and <5ms median additional pipeline latency under 500rps
Configuration exposed in Console and via API; rollout toggles per-tenant with gradual rollout support
Integration tests validate no loss of critical tracing keys used by existing dashboards and alerting rules
comments: 2025-11-12 Aisha Patel: Kickoff - scoped initial spike to investigate common attribute explosions observed in production (see incident-2025-10-29). Focus on allowlist strategy and exporter-specific envelope negotiation.
